applicabilityBasis.summary: ZARU is a transferable fixed-rand payment and settlement token, redeemable 1:1 for South African rand through authorised platforms, with no interest, fund-share or bank-deposit rights described in the issuer FAIS disclosure. Reserve investment in a money-market fund does not make holders owners of that fund.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. Current issuerEntity is BlockTower South Africa (Pty) Ltd: issuer FAIS disclosure updated 2026-08-26 names registration 2025/058159/07 and ZARU; Moore report dated 2026-10-01 explicitly describes the company as formerly Loop South Africa (Pty) Ltd. Older white paper and privacy page retain the Loop name. This replaces the existing issuerEntity Loop South Africa (Pty) Ltd trading as BlockTower and requires approval because the Safety Score issuer key changes. The exact tracked Solana mint is corroborated by both reserve reports. ZARU is a transferable fixed-rand payment/settlement token, not a fluctuating fund share; cash and money-market funds are reserve assets. Institutional primary and partner retail redemptions have eligibility, compliance and liquidity conditions. Current issuer distribution identifies South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya and Uganda; no EU offer or admission was established. Latest issuer-linked report covers 2026-08-31 and is dated 2026-10-01 despite the homepage label September, 2026. Both it and the July snapshot report are AUP engagements explicitly without assurance opinion or conclusion. Two public monthly snapshots plus a reporting promise do not establish a continuous monthly publication cadence; monthlyAttestationPresent remains conservatively false. South African FSCA claims are issuer disclosures, not U.S. permission. No qualifying public GENIUS approval/application, foreign registration/comparability determination or matching enforcement action was found in the dated scoped review, including the new and former legal names. Foreign exception and pathway remain unknown. General GENIUS regulator materials remain proposals; SCRC procedures do not activate substantive obligations. DASP restrictions are not yet effective.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the consulted primary regulator sources, public directory and issuer disclosures and scoped token/legal-name searches did not identify a token-specific PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official pending GENIUS application or foreign-issuer registration/comparability determination for ZARU / BlockTower South Africa (Pty) Ltd (formerly Loop South Africa (Pty) Ltd). This records bounded public negative evidence, not a ruling that the token is unlawful, that no confidential filing exists or that the foreign jurisdiction has been rejected. No matching public enforcement action was located in the scoped searches.
